newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Quoted mostly steady on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Quoted mostly steady on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted mostly unchanged on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus none on Friday.
- Three barges, Louisiana, Missouri River, this week no bid, offer 117-1/2 percent, unchanged from June 27.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week July, no bid, offer 107-1/2 percent, unchanged from June 27.
- Eight barges, upper Mississippi (St. Paul-Savage), two each week of July, bid 135 percent, unchanged from June 27, similar, offer, one each week at 145 percent, unchanged.
- Five barges, Illinois River, one each week of August, bid 115 percent of tariff, unchanged from June 27, offer 125 percent, unchanged.
